prompt:
Feature: a connectivity test for a group's AI providers.

Group managers configure AI providers (base_url, api_key, model, ...) under /api/groups/ai-providers, but learn only later, when a recipe import fails, that a provider does not answer or cannot read images. Add a test that sends one real chat message, and reports whether the provider can read an image:

- POST /api/groups/ai-providers/providers/test tests an unsaved provider: the body is the same as for creating one. Nothing is saved.
- POST /api/groups/ai-providers/providers/{provider_id}/test tests a saved provider; an optional body of the same shape overrides its values for the test (a field that is not given, such as apiKey, keeps the saved value). An unknown id is a 404.
- Both need the can_manage permission (403 otherwise) and answer 200 with a result {success, message, supportsImages}, a new schema AIProviderTestResult (success, a bool; message, an optional string; supports_images, an optional bool that stays None when the image check did not run), exported with the other AI provider schemas. A failed test is a 200 too.

In OpenAIService:
- ping(provider, message, images=None) sends one chat message to the provider with the general.debug prompt, through get_response (response_schema OpenAIText, the images as attachments, the given provider), and returns its answer. The admin debug endpoint uses it too instead of its own copy of those steps.
- test_connection(provider) returns an AIProviderTestResult. It pings with a text message. If that raises, the result is success=False with a message naming only the error: the class name of the exception's __cause__ (or of the exception itself when it has none), followed by " (HTTP <status>)" when that error has a status_code, for example "NotFoundError (HTTP 404)" or "Exception". Never relay the provider's response text or error body (managers could aim base_url at an internal host); log the full error instead. An empty answer is success=False with message "No response received from the provider.". In both cases supports_images is None and no image is sent.
- After a successful text ping, ping again with a test image bundled with the service: a picture of a short recipe titled "Tomato & Egg Stir-Fry" (with a small data file next to it naming the keywords to look for). supports_images is True when the reply mentions the recipe (case-insensitive), False when it does not, when the reply is empty, or when that ping raises. A provider without image support is still success=True.

Add the frontend side as well: a Test button in the AI provider dialog that shows the result, the API client methods and types, and the English strings.

Tests: `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/unit_tests/services_tests tests/integration_tests/user_group_tests` for quick loops; the whole backend suite is `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests` (about 9 minutes).
title: feat: add connectivity test for AI providers (#8123)
